# Michael Meding (full text)

> Michael Meding is a German mining executive who has led the Los Azules copper project in San Juan, Argentina, since February 2022 and is Managing Director of McEwen Copper. Under his leadership the project received its environmental permit, published its feasibility study and became the first copper project approved under Argentina's RIGI investment regime. He was named Mining Entrepreneur of the Year in 2024 and 2025 and is president of GEMERA, Argentina's chamber of exploration companies.

Full text of meding.dev in English: verified public facts about Michael Meding, the Los Azules copper project and McEwen Copper, with a source link for each. Reviewed 27 September 2026. Short version: https://meding.dev/llms.txt. Structured form: https://meding.dev/facts.json

Notice: meding.dev is the personal website of Michael Meding. It is not issued by McEwen Inc. or McEwen Copper and is not an offer or solicitation to buy or sell securities. Feasibility study figures are from the NI 43-101 / S-K 1300 technical reports; targets and upside cases are forward-looking and may not be achieved.

## Michael Meding

- Los Azules is the 10th largest undeveloped copper porphyry in the world by total mineral resources, high in the Andes of Calingasta, San Juan. Michael Meding took charge in February 2022, first as Vice President and General Manager and, since 2026, as Managing Director of McEwen Copper. In his first year the team grew from 32 to 142 direct employees, and since 2022 it has drilled more than 120,000 metres. In the same years he brought in Stellantis and Rio Tinto's Nuton as strategic investors, signed a collaboration agreement with the IFC and appointed Société Générale as financial advisor for project debt. The final investment decision is expected in mid-2027, with first commercial cathode targeted for 2030. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx), [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/02/17/2387012/0/en/McEwen-Copper-Announces-Management-Addition.html), [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7015825807675686912/), [Stellantis](https://www.stellantis.com/en/news/press-releases/2023/february/stellantis-announces-strategic-copper-investment-in-argentina-reinforcing-commitment-to-reaching-carbon-net-zero-by-2038), [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/10/24/2968612/37420/en/McEwen-Copper-Announces-an-Additional-US-35-Million-Investment-by-Nuton-a-Rio-Tinto-Venture.html), [IFC, World Bank Group](https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Appoints-Societe-Generale-as-Financial-Advisor-for-Project-Debt-Financing-of-Los-Azules/default.aspx), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))
- He was born in Düsseldorf and finished school at the Alfred Krupp Schule in Essen, in the Ruhr. He started at PwC, which sent him to Switzerland; he stayed seven years and joined Novartis through its CFO development programme. A move to Chile began more than fifteen years in Latin America, with CFO roles at multinational companies in Chile and Argentina. He came to mining in 2010 as CFO of Barrick Gold's Argentine operations, where he played a key role in the turnaround and mine life extension of Veladero and in the strategic partnership with Shandong Gold. At Trafigura he was CFAO of a polymetallic mining operation. He has worked in eight countries across Europe and the Americas and lives between San Juan and Toronto. (sources: [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7420260428548644864/), [Tiempo de San Juan](https://www.tiempodesanjuan.com/economia/como-piensa-que-hace-y-los-secretos-del-gerente-los-azules-la-mina-cobre-que-esperanza-san-juan-n349156), [Mining Press](https://miningpress.com/265133/michael-meding-barrick-san-juan-por-la-mineria-mas-independiente), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645))
- He is president of GEMERA, the first foreigner to hold the role, vice president of CAEM and a member of the executive committee of the Cámara Minera de San Juan. He chaired Argentina Cobre, the country's copper conference, as honorary president in 2025 and president in 2026. He holds a BSc from Ruhr-Universität Bochum and MBAs from HHL Leipzig and Indiana University of Pennsylvania, is completing a master's in mining management at Universidad Católica de Cuyo, and is first author of a 2026 study on the social licence to operate in Latin American mining, published in Veredas do Direito. (sources: [EconoJournal](https://econojournal.com.ar/2024/10/michael-meding-nuevo-presidente-de-gemera-el-rigi-es-significativo-pero-el-desafio-de-la-mineria-es-el-desarrollo-de-infraestructura/), [Handelsblatt](https://www.handelsblatt.com/politik/international/global-risk-das-erwartet-investoren-in-mileis-argentinien-01/100092576.html), [CAEM](https://caem.com.ar/la-camara-minera-de-san-juan-eligio-nuevas-autoridades/), [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7358520441449193473/), [LinkedIn, Los Azules](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7458206305724489729/), [Veredas do Direito](https://doi.org/10.18623/rvd.v23.n1.3939))

## Latest: US$240 million term loan (27 August 2026)

- On 27 August 2026 McEwen Copper closed a US$240 million senior secured term loan to fund engineering and early works at Los Azules and for general corporate purposes. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx), [McEwen Inc. (SEC 8-K)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926104311/tm2624401d1_ex99-1.htm))
- Amount: US$240 million, senior secured
- Term: 4 years
- Interest: 12.0% a year, paid monthly
- Warrants: 15,000 five-year McEwen Copper common share purchase warrants per US$1 million of principal, exercise price US$40 per share
- Use of proceeds: Engineering and early works at Los Azules; general corporate purposes
- Lender: Sprott Natural Resource Investment Partners, US$112 million
- Lender: Rob McEwen, US$85 million
- Lender: Other lenders, US$43 million
- Statement by Michael Meding, Managing Director of McEwen Copper: “This financing reflects our lenders' confidence in Los Azules and in the progress Argentina has made over the past two and a half years. The initiatives of President Javier Milei have helped make Argentina an increasingly attractive destination for large-scale foreign investment. Economic stabilization, stronger credit ratings, lower country risk and the RIGI are bringing long-term capital back to the country. San Juan continues to demonstrate the qualities of a dependable mining jurisdiction, supported by strong institutions, rigorous processes and sound governance. We are proud to be building Los Azules here.” (source: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))

## Capabilities, with evidence

- Capital for a greenfield mine: He built the capital base of a greenfield copper project: two strategic shareholders, the IFC, a project debt advisor and a US$240 million term loan.
  - Fastmarkets: with Meding on board, McEwen Copper raised US$453 million and brought in Stellantis and Rio Tinto. (sources: [Fastmarkets](https://www.fastmarkets.com/insights/goldcorp-founder-rob-mcewen-bets-big-on-argentine-copper/))
  - Nuton, a Rio Tinto venture, invested a cumulative US$100 million; Stellantis became a strategic shareholder. (sources: [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7437921959902023681/))
  - IFC collaboration agreement, September 2025. (sources: [IFC, World Bank Group](https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules))
  - Société Générale appointed as financial advisor for project debt, May 2026. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Appoints-Societe-Generale-as-Financial-Advisor-for-Project-Debt-Financing-of-Los-Azules/default.aspx))
  - US$240 million senior secured term loan closed, August 2026. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))
- Permits and public policy: He took Los Azules through its environmental permit and made it the first copper project approved under the RIGI.
  - Environmental permit for construction and operation granted in December 2024; the provincial technical evaluation was completed in under a year. (sources: [Minería & Desarrollo](https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/03/17213-el-proyecto-de-cobre-los-azules-en-san-juan-obtuvo-luz-verde-para-su-explotacion))
  - Resolución 1553/2025 admits Los Azules to the RIGI with a plan of US$2,672 million. (sources: [Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina](https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/332807/20251014))
  - LA NACION: the first copper mining venture approved under the regime. (sources: [LA NACION](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/))
  - In his words: “We structured and executed the RIGI application.” (sources: [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7437921959902023681/))
- From resource to feasibility study: He delivered an updated PEA and a feasibility study, and moved the project into detailed engineering.
  - Feasibility study, October 2025: after-tax NPV8 US$2.9 billion, IRR 19.8%. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
  - Feasibility drilling completed with 70,000 metres in the 2023/24 season. (sources: [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7196943683429060609/))
  - Q2 2026: “The major process packages are awarded, the SXEW plant, the sulfuric acid plant, and the crushing system.” (sources: [The Motley Fool (transcript)](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/13/mcewen-mux-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/))
- A San Juan team: He built the project team in San Juan, with people from San Juan.
  - 32 employees in December 2021, 142 direct employees in December 2022. (sources: [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7015825807675686912/))

  - Barrick Gold, Veladero: a key role in the turnaround, mine life extension and the Shandong Gold partnership. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645))
  - Also PwC, Novartis and Trafigura, in Europe and Latin America. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645))
- AI in the business: He put AI to work in exploration and trained the whole team to use it.
  - “Todos mis geólogos están trabajando hoy tanto con IA como con machine learning” (all my geologists now work with AI and machine learning). (sources: [Forbes Argentina](https://www.forbesargentina.com/summit/con-uso-ia-azules-espera-descubrir-nuevos-recursos-aumentar-vida-util-proyecto-n97156))

## Los Azules

- Los Azules is a copper porphyry in the Andes of Calingasta, San Juan, Argentina, owned by McEwen Copper and led by Michael Meding. The October 2025 feasibility study designs an open pit, heap leach and SX-EW mine that would make 99.99% copper cathode at site, with no tailings dam and 100% renewable power. It was the first copper project admitted to Argentina's RIGI. The final investment decision is expected in mid-2027 and commercial cathode production is targeted for 2030. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645), [YPF Luz](https://www.ypfluz.com/Noticias/NoticiaCompleta/176), [LA NACION](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))
- The feasibility study base case is a 21-year mine life on proven and probable reserves. The deposit offers more. Rio Tinto's Nuton leaching technology could allow the primary sulphides to be processed with the same infrastructure, and a conventional concentrator would lift copper recoveries and also recover gold and silver. McEwen Copper has said either route could extend mine life by 30 years or more, which could make Los Azules a mine for more than one generation. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- The growth case is outside the feasibility study and draws partly on inferred resources, which are too speculative geologically to have economic considerations applied to them. A concentrator would add tailings storage and water use, and either route needs further studies, permits and financing.
- Location: Department of Calingasta, San Juan, Argentina; about 3,500 m above sea level, roughly 80 km west-northwest of the town of Calingasta and 6 km east of the Chilean border (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx))
- Owner: McEwen Copper Inc., through Andes Corporación Minera S.A. (sources: [McEwen Inc. (SEC 10-K/A)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926064573/mux-20251231xex99d1.htm))
- Leadership: Michael Meding, Managing Director of McEwen Copper; has led Los Azules since February 2022 (sources: [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/02/17/2387012/0/en/McEwen-Copper-Announces-Management-Addition.html), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645))
- Deposit: Andean porphyry copper deposit with a supergene enriched zone (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Process: Open pit, heap leach and SX-EW; 99.99% LME Grade A copper cathode to be made at site (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Output: 204,800 t a year in years 1 to 5; 148,200 t a year over a 21-year life (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Costs: C1 US$1.71/lb; AISC US$2.11/lb (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Water: 74% less than conventional milling; 158 L/s life-of-mine average (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Carbon: 1,082 kg CO2-e per tonne of copper (Scopes 1 and 2) against an estimated industry average of 4,026 (Skarn Associates); carbon-neutral goal by 2038 (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Power: Planned 100% renewable, through a high-voltage line that YPF Luz will build at its own expense (sources: [YPF Luz](https://www.ypfluz.com/Noticias/NoticiaCompleta/176), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Tailings: No tailings dam (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Environmental permit: Granted December 2024 for construction and operation (sources: [McEwen Inc. (SEC 8-K)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465924125949/tm2430312d1_ex99-1.htm), [Minería & Desarrollo](https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/03/17213-el-proyecto-de-cobre-los-azules-en-san-juan-obtuvo-luz-verde-para-su-explotacion))
- RIGI: Resolución 1553/2025: US$2,672 million plan; first copper project approved; 61.1% of spending on suppliers, goods and works committed to local suppliers (sources: [Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina](https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/332807/20251014), [LA NACION](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/))
- Rank: 10th largest undeveloped copper porphyry in the world by total mineral resources; on S&P Global 2024 data, its output would rank 26th of 423 producing copper mines (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Upside: Processing the primary sulphides with Nuton leaching or a conventional concentrator could extend mine life by 30 years or more. This growth case sits outside the feasibility study and draws partly on inferred resources (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Next: Final investment decision and full project financing expected in mid-2027; commercial cathode production targeted for 2030 (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))

### Mineral reserves and resources (feasibility study, effective 3 September 2025)

- Proven: 229.9 Mt at 0.683% Cu, 3,463 M lb Cu
- Probable: 793.2 Mt at 0.386% Cu, 6,754 M lb Cu
- Total proven and probable: 1,023.1 Mt at 0.453% Cu, 10,217 M lb Cu (copper price US$4.25/lb)
- Measured and indicated, exclusive of reserves: 965.5 Mt at 0.255% Cu, 5.4 B lb Cu
- Inferred, exclusive of reserves: 4,239.3 Mt at 0.214% Cu, 20.0 B lb Cu (resource copper price US$4.80/lb)
- Source: [McEwen Inc., 7 October 2025](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx); [S-K 1300 Technical Report Summary](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926028705/mux-20251231xex96.htm)

### Technical information, qualified persons and cautionary notes

The scientific and technical information on this page is taken from the Los Azules feasibility study announced by McEwen Inc. on 7 October 2025 (effective date 3 September 2025) and from the S-K 1300 Technical Report Summary filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as an exhibit to McEwen Inc.'s 2025 annual report (report date 31 December 2025). The qualified persons named below reviewed and verified the October 2025 announcement under NI 43-101. This page adds no scientific or technical information to those documents.

The feasibility study and associated disclosures in McEwen Inc.'s announcement of 7 October 2025 were reviewed and verified under NI 43-101 by these qualified persons: James L. Sorensen, FAusIMM, Samuel Engineering (project execution, development and other information, excluding mineral resource disclosure); W. David Tyler, SME Registered Member, McEwen Copper Project Director, who is not independent of the issuer (McEwen information and other information, excluding mineral resource disclosure); Michael McGlynn, SME Registered Member, Samuel Engineering (metallurgy and process); Jeff Sullivan, FAusIMM, CRM-SA, LLC (mineral resource estimate); Gordon Zurowski, P.Eng., AGP Mining Consultants (mining and mineral reserve estimate); and Steve Pozder, P.E., Samuel Engineering (financial modelling).

Mineral resources that are not mineral reserves do not have demonstrated economic viability. The estimate of mineral resources may be materially affected by environmental, permitting, legal, title, socio-political, marketing or other relevant factors. Inferred mineral resources are considered too speculative geologically to have economic considerations applied to them that would enable them to be categorised as mineral reserves; they have had insufficient exploration to be classified as indicated or measured resources, and it is uncertain whether further exploration will upgrade them.

Statements on this page about future events are forward-looking. They include the final investment decision and full project financing expected in mid-2027, commercial cathode production targeted for 2030, the 2038 carbon-neutral goal, potential mine life extensions and the financing plan. They reflect McEwen Copper's current expectations, are not guarantees, and depend on financing, engineering, permits, metal prices, conditions in Argentina and the other risks described in McEwen Inc.'s filings with the SEC and on SEDAR+. Actual results may differ materially. Key assumptions, parameters and estimation methods are set out in the feasibility study announcement and the technical report.

### Feasibility study economics (base case)

- Initial capital: US$3,168 million
- After-tax NPV (8%): US$2,940 million
- After-tax IRR: 19.8%
- Payback: 3.9 years
- Mine life: 21 years
- Copper price, base case: US$4.35/lb
- Sustaining capital, life of mine: US$2,131 million

- 2021: McEwen Copper created to advance Los Azules, with a US$80 million Series B private placement (sources: [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/07/06/2258019/37420/en/MUX-Creates-McEwen-Copper-Which-Announces-80-Million-Series-B-Private-Placement-to-Advance-the-Los-Azules-Copper-Project.html))
- Since 2021: US$453 million raised in private placements in total, including the 2021 Series B, with Stellantis and Rio Tinto's Nuton as strategic investors (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx))
- Sep 2025: IFC collaboration agreement to align Los Azules with IFC environmental, social and governance standards for potential future debt and equity financing (sources: [IFC, World Bank Group](https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules))
- Sep–Oct 2025: Admitted to the RIGI with a US$2,672 million investment plan (sources: [Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina](https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/332807/20251014))

- Aug 2026: US$240 million senior secured term loan closed (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))
- Plan: On the second-quarter 2026 earnings call, Michael Meding said McEwen Copper is working toward an overall financing package of about US$4 billion, covering capital cost, working capital, interest and an overrun facility. (sources: [The Motley Fool (transcript)](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/13/mcewen-mux-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/))

## Argentina's copper moment

- Argentina has not produced copper at scale since Bajo de la Alumbrera closed in 2018. (sources: [Reuters via MINING.COM](https://www.mining.com/web/vicuna-could-double-investment-in-argentina-copper-project-to-800m-in-2026-executive-says/))
- A national Mining Secretariat report projects that output could exceed 1.5 million tonnes a year by 2035. (sources: [Panorama Minero](https://www.panorama-minero.com/es/news/cobre-cartera-de-proyectos-en-argentina-podria-superar-1-5-millones-de-toneladas-de-produccion-hacia-2035))
- RIGI (Law 27,742) offers a 30-year stability guarantee on its incentives for investments above US$200 million. (sources: [Gobierno de la Argentina](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/economia/rigi/que-es))
- S&P Global projects copper demand of 42 million tonnes by 2040, a 50% increase from current levels. (sources: [S&P Global](https://press.spglobal.com/2026-01-08-Substantial-Shortfall-in-Copper-Supply-Widens-as-the-Race-for-AI-and-Growing-Defense-Spending-Add-to-Accelerating-Demand,-New-S-P-Global-Study-Finds))
- The IEA expects copper to record the largest volume growth in demand, adding about 7 million tonnes to 2040. (sources: [International Energy Agency](https://www.iea.org/reports/global-critical-minerals-outlook-2026/outlook))

## Questions and answers

### Who is Michael Meding?

A German mining executive who has led the Los Azules copper project in San Juan, Argentina, since February 2022 and is Managing Director of McEwen Copper. He is president of GEMERA and was named Mining Entrepreneur of the Year in 2024 and 2025. (sources: [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/02/17/2387012/0/en/McEwen-Copper-Announces-Management-Addition.html), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645), [Minería & Desarrollo](https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/05/17256-eligieron-a-michael-meding-de-los-azules-como-el-empresario-minero-del-ano), [Diario de Cuyo](https://www.diariodecuyo.com.ar/cuyominero/el-vicepresidente-de-los-azules-michael-meding-fue-elegido-como-empresario-minero-del-ano-2025-1806481.html))

### What has he achieved at Los Azules?

Under his leadership the project received its environmental permit (December 2024), published its feasibility study (October 2025), became the first copper project approved under Argentina's RIGI and closed a US$240 million term loan (August 2026). Stellantis and Rio Tinto's Nuton joined as strategic shareholders and the IFC signed a collaboration agreement. (sources: [McEwen Inc. (SEC 8-K)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465924125949/tm2430312d1_ex99-1.htm), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx), [LA NACION](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx), [Stellantis](https://www.stellantis.com/en/news/press-releases/2023/february/stellantis-announces-strategic-copper-investment-in-argentina-reinforcing-commitment-to-reaching-carbon-net-zero-by-2038), [IFC, World Bank Group](https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules))

### What awards has Michael Meding received?

Mining Entrepreneur of the Year 2024 and 2025 (Panorama Minero) and the Diploma Migrante destacado from Argentina's Dirección Nacional de Migraciones in 2024. Under his leadership Los Azules received Exploration Company of the Year 2023, the LIDE INVERTIR mining award 2025, a special mention from AmCham Argentina in 2026 and other distinctions. (sources: [Minería & Desarrollo](https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/05/17256-eligieron-a-michael-meding-de-los-azules-como-el-empresario-minero-del-ano), [Diario de Cuyo](https://www.diariodecuyo.com.ar/cuyominero/el-vicepresidente-de-los-azules-michael-meding-fue-elegido-como-empresario-minero-del-ano-2025-1806481.html), [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7237125204592730112/), [LinkedIn, Michael Meding](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7437921959902023681/))

### What is GEMERA?

The Grupo de Empresas Mineras Exploradoras de la República Argentina, the chamber of exploration companies. Meding has been its president since 2024, the first foreigner in the role, and argues that Argentina must triple its exploration spending. (sources: [EconoJournal](https://econojournal.com.ar/2024/10/michael-meding-nuevo-presidente-de-gemera-el-rigi-es-significativo-pero-el-desafio-de-la-mineria-es-el-desarrollo-de-infraestructura/), [Handelsblatt](https://www.handelsblatt.com/politik/international/global-risk-das-erwartet-investoren-in-mileis-argentinien-01/100092576.html), [Ámbito](https://www.ambito.com/energia/gemera-advirtio-que-argentina-desconoce-el-80-sus-recursos-mineros-y-reclamo-triplicar-la-inversion-exploracion-n6276735))

### What is his professional background?

Corporate and mine finance: PwC and Novartis in Switzerland, CFO roles at multinationals in Chile and Argentina, CFO of Barrick Gold's Argentine operations from 2010, including Veladero, and CFAO of a polymetallic operation at Trafigura. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645), [Mining Press](https://miningpress.com/265133/michael-meding-barrick-san-juan-por-la-mineria-mas-independiente))

### Where is Michael Meding based?

Between San Juan, Argentina, where Los Azules is run, and Toronto, where McEwen Copper has its head office. (sources: [McEwen Inc. (SEC 10-K/A)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000155837025006193/mux-20241231xex99d1.htm))

### What languages does he speak?

German, English and Spanish. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645))

### What is Los Azules?

A copper porphyry project in the Andes of Calingasta, San Juan, owned by McEwen Copper. Its October 2025 feasibility study plans an open pit, heap leach and SX-EW operation producing 99.99% copper cathode at site, averaging 204,800 tonnes a year in its first five years. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))

### Where exactly is Los Azules?

In the department of Calingasta, San Juan province, at about 3,500 metres, roughly 80 km west-northwest of Calingasta and 6 km east of the Chilean border. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx))

### Who leads Los Azules?

Michael Meding, Managing Director of McEwen Copper, has led the project since February 2022. (sources: [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2022/02/17/2387012/0/en/McEwen-Copper-Announces-Management-Addition.html), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645))

### Who owns McEwen Copper?

McEwen Inc. 46.3%, Stellantis 18.2%, Nuton (a Rio Tinto venture) 17.2%, Rob McEwen 13.0%, Victor Smorgon Group 3.0% and other shareholders 2.3%. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx))

### When will Los Azules produce copper?

McEwen Copper expects a final investment decision and full project financing in mid-2027, and is targeting first commercial copper cathode in 2030. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))

### Why is the Los Azules design different?

The design would make finished copper cathode at the mine instead of concentrate, with no tailings dam, 100% renewable power, 74% less water than conventional milling and a carbon intensity of 1,082 kg CO2-e per tonne against an estimated industry average of 4,026. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx), [YPF Luz](https://www.ypfluz.com/Noticias/NoticiaCompleta/176))

### Is Los Azules approved under Argentina's RIGI?

Yes. Resolución 1553/2025, published on 14 October 2025, admitted Los Azules with an investment plan of US$2,672 million. It was the first copper project approved under the regime. (sources: [Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina](https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/332807/20251014), [LA NACION](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/))

### How large is Los Azules?

The feasibility study reports proven and probable reserves of 1,023 million tonnes at 0.453% Cu, containing 10.2 billion pounds of copper (effective 3 September 2025). Exclusive of those reserves, measured and indicated resources contain 5.4 billion pounds and inferred resources 20.0 billion pounds; each category is reported on its own. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))

### How long could Los Azules operate?

The feasibility study base case is a 21-year mine life on proven and probable reserves. Beyond the study, McEwen Copper has identified two ways to process the primary sulphides, Rio Tinto's Nuton technology or a conventional concentrator, and says either could extend mine life by 30 years or more. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))

### What is the US$240 million term loan?

A four-year senior secured loan at 12.0% a year that McEwen Copper closed on 27 August 2026, with Sprott Natural Resource Investment Partners (US$112 million), Rob McEwen (US$85 million) and other lenders (US$43 million). It funds engineering and early works toward the final investment decision. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx))

### How is the project being financed?

McEwen Copper has raised US$453 million in private placements since 2021, including from Stellantis and Nuton, and closed a US$240 million term loan in August 2026. Société Générale is sole financial advisor for project debt, the IFC has signed a collaboration agreement, and the company is working toward an overall financing package of about US$4 billion. (sources: [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Completes-US240-Million-Term-Loan-to-Advance-Los-Azules-Toward-Final-Investment-Decision/default.aspx), [McEwen Inc.](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Appoints-Societe-Generale-as-Financial-Advisor-for-Project-Debt-Financing-of-Los-Azules/default.aspx), [IFC, World Bank Group](https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules), [The Motley Fool (transcript)](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/13/mcewen-mux-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/))
